lines.text: Keep moving! Don't look back, or I swear I'll pull the trigger!
Please, just let me go! I didn't see anything!
Sit on the floor. Hands on your head.
Who was that girl at the gas station? Why did your partner want her?
She saw something she wasn't supposed to see. Just like you.
Police! We know you're in there! Drop the weapon and send the kid out first!
It's the cops! Let me go!
Stop! Listen! Where are the sirens? There are no red and blue lights out there!
Sam... you left my cruiser on the highway. Open the door, hand me the kid, and I'll forget you messed up.
He's lying. He never leaves witnesses. He's gonna shoot both of us the second that door opens. Come with me into the tunnel!
Last chance, kid! Unlock the door and walk out. I only want Sam!
Trust the killer outside... or crawl into the dark with the one who just held a gun to my head?
